definition.en: A warm, bright feeling when something makes you very happy.
definition.zh: 发生让你很开心的事时，心里充满明亮、愉快的感觉。

scene.en: You see the sunflower you planted finally bloom.
scene.zh: 你亲手种的向日葵终于开花了。

alt.en: A girl lifts up a sunflower she has grown.
alt.zh: 女孩捧起自己种出的向日葵。

definition.en: An upset feeling when you try hard but something still does not work.
definition.zh: 努力尝试了很多次，事情还是不顺利时，产生的烦躁和失落。

scene.en: Your block tower falls down again, even though you have tried carefully.
scene.zh: 你认真地搭积木，可积木塔又倒了。

alt.en: A girl sits next to a collapsed tower of wooden blocks.
alt.zh: 女孩坐在倒塌的积木塔旁边。

definition.en: A sad feeling of wanting company or connection but not having it right now.
definition.zh: 希望有人陪伴或理解自己，却暂时没有这样的陪伴时的失落感。

scene.en: You sit on a bench while other children are playing far away.
scene.zh: 别的孩子在远处玩，你一个人坐在长椅上。

alt.en: A girl holding a plush toy watches other children play from a bench.
alt.zh: 女孩抱着玩偶坐在长椅上，看着远处玩耍的孩子。

definition.en: A gentle, caring feeling that makes you want to be close to someone.
definition.zh: 很在乎一个人或小动物，想亲近、关心或拥抱时的温柔感受。

scene.en: Your dog runs to greet you, and you give it a gentle hug.
scene.zh: 小狗跑来迎接你，你开心地轻轻抱住它。

say.en: I love giving my dog a hug.
say.zh: 我好喜欢我的小狗，想抱抱它。

alt.en: A girl kneels by a doorway and hugs a friendly dog.
alt.zh: 女孩在门口跪坐着拥抱一只友好的小狗。

definition.en: A lighter feeling when something you were worried about turns out okay.
definition.zh: 原本让你担心的事情终于没事了，紧绷的心慢慢放松下来。

scene.en: You thought you had lost your favorite book, but then you find it in your school bag.
scene.zh: 你以为心爱的书丢了，后来发现它就在书包里。

say.en: What a relief! I found it.
say.zh: 呼！找到了，我松了一口气。

alt.en: A girl smiles and holds a favorite book found in her school bag.
alt.zh: 女孩从书包里找到心爱的书，露出放心的笑容。
